text.en: Stir cornstarch smooth in a cool liquid first, then add it to the hot liquid.
text.de: Speisestärke zuerst in kalter Flüssigkeit glatt rühren, dann in die heiße Flüssigkeit geben.

why.en: The cool liquid keeps the starch grains apart so they do not clump.
why.de: Die kalte Flüssigkeit hält die Stärkekörner auseinander, sodass sie nicht klumpen.

sources.title: Flavors of the Saucier: Stocks, Sauces and Soups (Zeringue and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: Cornstarch must be mixed with a cool liquid before it is introduced into a hot one.

sources.title: Flavors of the Saucier: Stocks, Sauces and Soups (Zeringue and Thibodeaux)
sources.sentence: The cool liquid separates the grains of starch and allows them to begin absorbing liquid without lumping.
